doc.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has really been a pleasure for us.
It’s fun. I hope I told you some good things.
Yeah, you did. And I hope we can get to hear you play tonight, too.
Yeah, yeah. Well I don’t think it should be any problem. We should be able to do that.
All right. On behalf of Hamilton College, I’d like to thank Roy McCurdy for sharing his experiences with us. And have a good gig.
Thank you, I really loved it. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -15-
